title: kv-cache: memory-aware eviction, adaptive spillover and defrag heuristics
author: Priya Patel
description: Motivation: we observed periodic OOMs and p99 latency spikes when the KV cache fragmented under a mixed tail/interactive workload. This PR implements a memory-aware eviction pipeline: (1) adaptive spillover to host (pinned paging) before OOM, (2) background defragmentation (coalesce/free lists and compaction of small fragments), and (3) an eviction priority heuristic that prefers cold, large-fragment entries to minimize fragmentation and I/O. Summary: adds a memory budget watcher, a spillover allocator that pages cold KV segments to host RAM, a background compactor thread that merges adjacent free ranges, and an eviction scorer that accounts for last-access, size, and fragmentation penalty. Implementation notes: most logic lives in redwood/runtime/kv_cache (kv_manager.go, spillover.go, compactor.go). Spillover uses an async I/O queue and a small prefetch window for recently-demoted keys. Eviction scoring is pluggable and tests can toggle heuristics via --kv-evict-policy. This PR also adds unit and integration tests that exercise heavy fragmentation, simulated host paging, and race conditions. Performance: in internal canary with mixed 1k/20k token sequences we reduced OOM rate to 0/10k (was ~3/10k), decreased full-gc frequency by 6x, and saw 8-12% lower p99 latency on long-sequence tails due to fewer small-alloc churns. Rollout plan: staged rollout behind a feature flag (kv_adaptive_spillover) starting on dedicated Canary pool, monitor memory OOMs, p99 and throughput for 48h, then ramp cluster-wide. If regressions are seen, feature can be toggled off without state migration. Related work: builds on prior spillover prototypes (pr-20321, pr-21456) and integrates the compaction API introduced in pr-148512. Checklist: [x] unit tests, [x] integration tests, [x] canary benchmarks, [x] docs/console flags, [x] telemetry metrics (kv.spillover.ops, kv.compact.cycles, kv.eviction.score).

review_comments: Marco Alvarez: Can we make the compactor pause during high-CPU periods? Background compaction caused a small CPU spike in our perf lab.
Priya Patel (author): Added adaptive backoff to compactor when CPU > 70% and moved compaction to a low-priority scheduling class. See compactor.go:SchedulerBackoffPolicy.
Emily Chen: The eviction score looks sensible, but please add more unit tests around very large entries (100MB) — we must avoid excessive paging churn.
Priya Patel (author): Added large-entry unit tests and a size-threshold that forces direct eviction for > 64MB entries to avoid repeated paging loops.
Jinsoo Park: CI flaky test in kv_cache_test.go line ~412 — observed race on shutdown path.
Priya Patel (author): Fixed race by introducing a compactor shutdown barrier and added the reproducer to ci/testdata.
Marco Alvarez: Approve after addressing perf lab notes.
Emily Chen: LGTM, added an approval.
release_notes: Improved KV cache memory management: adaptive spillover to host, background defragmentation, and a new eviction heuristic that reduces fragmentation and OOMs under mixed workloads. Feature gated (kv_adaptive_spillover).
notes_for_ops: Enable kv_adaptive_spillover on Canary pool only initially. Watch metrics kv.spillover.ops, kv.compact.cycles, kv.eviction.count, memory. If p99 or OOM increases, toggle feature off. Backfill: toggling off leaves spillover pages on host but they are lazily reclaimed by background compactor.
